items.question: How many schools has Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Global Initiatives (MBRGI) constructed around the world?
items.fact: MBRGI constructed 2,126 schools worldwide in knowledge programmes.

items.question: How many hospitals has Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Global Initiatives (MBRGI) built?
items.fact: MBRGI and affiliated bodies have built 46 hospitals.
